def _union_version(union):
    """V3 (SF1): exact module/design-freeze/scheme/producer binding BEFORE any status use; absence refuses."""
    _require(type(union) is dict, 'union object required')
    for key, expected in (('module', MODULE), ('design_freeze_sha256', DESIGN_FREEZE_SHA256), ('scheme', SCHEME),
                          ('producer_sha256', SUPERVISOR19_SHA256)):
        value = union.get(key)
        shown = value[:80] if type(value) is str else type(value).__name__
        _require(type(value) is str and value == expected,
                 'union %s %r != %r: absent or built by another module/version' % (key, shown, expected))
    return True


def _v_union(union):
    _union_version(union)
    _require(type(union) is dict and union.get('format') == UNION_FORMAT and _hex(union.get('union_sha256')),
